title: WELP task-instance outcome record (CP-1)
description: Canonical per-generation-task outcome record per contracts/welp-outcomes-0.1.0-draft.json. Every generation-bearing phase emits one record per task instance; semantic is judged from the final-answer channel only, and incomplete output never auto-fails semantics.

id.description: Task id within the frozen fixture.

semantic.description: PASS/FAIL judged only from the usable final-answer channel; NOT_EVALUABLE is mandatory when no conclusion is supportable (empty answer, answerless truncation).

budget.description: UNKNOWN is honest when the reasoning/answer split cannot be attributed; guessing is prohibited.

finish_reason.description: Verbatim runtime finish_reason; null only when the runtime does not expose it (completion is then DERIVED from token accounting).

reasoning_tokens.description: Only when the runtime exposes the split; never inferred.

expectation_pass.description: Fixture-expectation result on the judged channel; null when the instance was not evaluable.

lane.description: operational | semantic — which declared lane produced the instance.

attribution.description: Failure attribution (model | runtime | hardware | scorer-artifact | protocol-limitation | unknown); never erases the measured result.
